transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… mostly I just can’t make myself do anything anymore. I sit in my room a lot, wearing the same clothes, and I don’t do the things I used to like—like knitting, journaling, or going for walks. When my mom asks me what’s wrong, I barely have the energy to answer her.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time?
I don’t really know. I wouldn’t say I feel sad all the time exactly… it’s more like I don’t feel much, or I’m just tired and blank.
Do you still enjoy the things you used to like, such as knitting or journaling, when you do find the energy to do them?

Not really. Even if I could pick up the knitting or open my journal, I just… don’t feel like doing it. Mostly I just stay in my room in the same clothes, and I don’t go on walks anymore. It feels like I can’t get myself to start anything.
Do you find pleasure in anything at all anymore?

Not really, no. I mostly just sit in my room. I don’t knit or write in my journal anymore, and I used to like going for walks, but I don’t even do that. It’s like I can’t get myself to do anything, and even talking to my mom feels like too much sometimes.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been checking my weight, and I don’t think I’ve noticed a big change.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
I… I’m not sure. I don’t really know how to answer that.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself that you feel you can talk about?
I don’t know. I don’t really want to talk about it, or… I’m not sure what counts. It’s hard to say.
Have you been having any thoughts about ending your life?
I’m not sure. I don’t really want to say yes or no because I don’t know how to explain it.
Are you having thoughts of wanting to end your life?
I don’t know. I can’t really say yes to that… but I can’t explain it well either.
Have you been experiencing any unusual thoughts or hearing voices that others don't hear?

I don’t really hear voices, but I do have thoughts that other people say are unusual. Since I was in those college classes, I’ve felt like the school portal and the clinic practicum people were using little wording changes in emails or assignment comments to mark me as someone they don’t want in healthcare. My mom says they’re just normal messages, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Do you believe that the school portal and clinic practicum people are actually trying to convey a hidden message to you or about you through their emails or comments?

Yes. I mean, I know it sounds strange, but yes. It feels like they’re putting small wording changes in the portal messages and comments on my work to show that they don’t want me in healthcare. My mom says they’re just normal emails, but I don’t think they are.
Do you think these hidden messages are just about you, or are they also trying to communicate something to others about you?

I think it’s about me, but also for other people to see. Like the wording in the portal or the assignment comments is marking me, showing the practicum people and maybe others that they don’t want me in healthcare. My mom says it’s just normal messages, but it really doesn’t feel like that to me.
Do you think the messages you believe are hidden in the emails and comments are specifically about you or could they be about something else?

I think they’re specifically about me. Like, since I was in those college classes, the wording in the school portal and the assignment comments felt like it was marking me as someone they don’t want in healthcare. My mom says they’re just regular messages, but I don’t think that’s all it is.
Do you think these hidden messages are real or just your imagination?

I think they’re real. I know my mom says it’s just normal emails or comments, but since I was in those college classes, it really felt like the little wording changes in the portal and practicum stuff were there to mark me, like they didn’t want me in healthcare. It doesn’t feel like I’m just imagining it.
Do you believe that events or things you see or hear in your daily life are specifically related to you or are about you, beyond what others might think?

Yes. I mean, mostly with the school stuff. Since I was in those college classes, I’ve felt like the school portal and the clinic practicum people were using small wording changes in emails or assignment comments to point at me. Like it was about me specifically, marking me as someone they didn’t want in healthcare. My mom says they’re just regular messages, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Are there any other unusual thoughts or beliefs you have, aside from the messages you think are hidden in the school emails and comments?
I’m not sure. I don’t think there’s anything else like that, at least not that I can explain. It’s mainly the school emails and comments that stand out to me.
Do you think these beliefs about the hidden messages would change if you weren't feeling so down and disconnected from things?

I don’t think it would change that much. Being down probably makes it harder to deal with, but the messages still seem real to me. Since those college classes, I’ve felt like the portal and the practicum comments had little wording changes meant to point me out, like they didn’t want me in healthcare. My mom says they’re just normal messages, but I don’t really believe that.
Are your beliefs about the hidden messages in the school emails and comments something you think about all the time, or do they come and go?

They come and go, but when I’m dealing with school stuff or thinking about those classes, it gets stuck in my head. I’ll look back at the emails or comments and the wording feels like it’s meant for me, like they’re marking me as someone they don’t want in healthcare. Even if my mom says it’s just normal, I still keep thinking about it.
How long have you been feeling this way, with little energy and interest in things?
It’s been going on for a while... since I started the community college program, so about two years and a couple months now. That’s when I feel like everything started declining.
Are your thoughts about the school portal and clinic practicum people trying to convey hidden messages to you something that you think about every day?

Not every minute of every day, but it’s there a lot. Especially when I see anything from the school portal or think about the clinic practicum. I start noticing the wording again, like in emails or comments, and it feels like they’re trying to mark me as someone they don’t want in healthcare. My mom says they’re just regular messages, but I still feel like there’s something behind them.
